name: Contribution heatmap
oneLiner: a glass panel of week-by-day squares stands on a lit floor and fills column by column in green (or the brand accent), busier toward today, while the camera rides the sweep and the running count rides above it on a glass pill; today lands brightest with a ring and a wave of light runs the year
say: when the speaker talks about showing up every day, a streak or a year of shipping ('I committed code every day for a year'): cut in on the habit, today's square lands on the number. color accent puts it in the brand colour
